new_inspiration_pattern.contract: Only after explicit researcher request, return a diversity-constrained bundle across Tool/Analogy/Mutation/Strange shelves; semantic-nearest-only ranking is forbidden as the sole strategy.
Only after accepted failure, retrieve analogous failures from failure_class + minimal_witness + broken_implication + surviving_invariant + newly_exposed_object.

new_question_generator.output: at least one boundary-extension, carrier-change, or coordinate-change research question

productive_failure_pattern.shape: FAILURE -> SURVIVING STRUCTURE -> NEW OBJECT/TOOL -> NEW QUESTION

questions: Which structural subclasses admit exact cheap normalization despite general hardness?
What is the sharp asymptotic funnel growth law after layerwise strictness is killed?
